content:
We need DBE for C12H15OCl. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (halogens count as H). O ignored. So treat Cl as H. So effective H = 15 + 1 =16. No N. DBE = 12 - 16/2 +1 = 12 -8 +1 =5. So integer 5.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we know. Could call retrieve_dbe_formula just to be safe.
